email.body1:
Jade, saw Schoox swept the 2026 Lighthouse Tech Awards for best frontline solution and best advance in practical AI.

Recognition like that usually opens more in-market accounts than a BDR team can personally touch before the buzz fades. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for Schoox off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Jade, quick follow-up for Schoox.

Award momentum drives inbound and interest faster than a BDR team can cover. Most teams don't actually know how many meetings they need to book to convert it, so the gap shows up late in the quarter.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I'll walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings Schoox needs to ride this momentum, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Jade, last bit of proof for Schoox.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks with every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Schoox's reply rate likely compares to other learning software teams. Want to hop on a quick call and I'll walk you through it?
email.body4:
Jade, I'll stop reaching out on this one, but didn't want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling pipeline without adding headcount isn't a priority right now, no problem at all. Timing is everything, and riding award momentum is its own kind of busy.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to a BDR motion? I'll tailor it to Schoox either way.
